messages:
sasha: Heads up 1: support ticket about sudden bill spikes from "projectless" keys. Customer says their org hit a higher rate band for ~45s and billed accordingly. We need a softer routing/quota model to avoid single-burst penalties.

rachel: ugh. saw that alert. console currently shows the "owner" flipping between project buckets which confuses support. Could we do a temporary soft-band that doesn't immediately debit project quota?

kevin: one thought: introduce a "soft-band" where routing uses project routing for latency/throughput decisions but billing debits a shadow counter until sustained. If sustained for Xs, we commit the real quota debit. That way short blips don't reassign billable ownership.

sasha: yeah exactly. shadow debit + commit window. If the burst is < commit_window we roll it into org-default billing, but still route to project so app latency benefits.

tay: risk: shadow counters could hide real usage and let projects exceed quotas if commit logic delayed. Need visibility in console & alerting.

kevin: agree. telemetry plan: add span tags: `routing.sticky_to`, `routing.sticky_reason`, `routing.bill_state` (shadow|committed). Store these in traces and index a 0.5% sample in logs with the full header. Console should render a small timeline in key detail showing shadow->commit transitions.

rachel: UX: under Key > Activity show a compact timeline row: [time] soft->commit (if any) with hover showing deltas. Also add a search filter `bill_state:shadow` for support queries.

sasha: config proposal (defaults): sticky_seconds=600, commit_window_sec=30, shadow_threshold_rps=20, max_shadow_bytes=1e9, commit_min_duration_sec=60. These are tunable via flags.

tay: what about DoS? If attackers keep sending short bursts, shadow counters could accumulate and then suddenly commit lots of debits. Maybe require shadow to decay exponentially (leaky bucket) and cap commit per hour.

kevin: good point. implement leaky decay: shadow_decay_per_sec = 0.01 * current_shadow (or fixed token leak), plus a commit_cap_per_hour per project. Also add anomaly rule: if shadow spikes > 2x avg and commit window is triggered, auto-create an incident for manual review.

sasha: API hooks: add POST /keys/:id/billing-override {billing_target: "org:default"|"project:foo", ttl_sec, reason}. Need admin scope and audit entry. Response should include prior bill_state.

rachel: console toggle "Prefer Org Billing for short bursts" that sets a per-key policy. Good for support to opt keys into more conservative billing.

ops-bot: feature-flag gate `soft_billing_band` enabled in staging at 1718830050 :white_check_mark:

tay: deployed to staging. running a synthetic trace now: 2k rps for 45s against a projectless key.

kevin: saw staging traces. two issues: 1) some spans show `routing.sticky_to` empty; 2) shadow counter increments, but commit never fired even when sustained >30s. Suspect off-by-one in commit timer.

sasha: I pushed a fix for commit timer and added more logging to the scheduler. Patch rolling to staging.

ops-bot: patch rolled to staging at 1718830125.

kevin: synthetic rerun: transition timeline looks right now. commit occurs at ~31s. Shadow decays afterwards. Posting dashboard screenshot in #eng-platform (link hidden).

rachel: can we also add a per-key analytics job that computes 7d rolling commit rate and average shadow duration? Will help tune defaults.

sasha: yes, add job `billing_shadow_aggregator` to backlog. Also adding metrics: `shadow_commits_total`, `shadow_reverts_total`, `shadow_bytes_committed`.

tay: rollout plan: start with 2% of keys for 72h, monitor support tickets and billing diffs, then 10% for a week, then 100%. Include a rollback kill-switch in console.

sasha: will draft RFC and include migration notes for existing projects that rely on immediate billing. Also list corner cases: cross-project proxies, delegated keys, and sa-token flows.

kevin: small note: make sure billing export includes shadow events (shadow->commit) as separate rows so downstream billing can reconcile.

rachel: agreed. support asked for a human-readable reason field in logs: reason values (sustained, manual, anomaly) so they can search easily.

sasha: final default config we plan to ship to canary feature flag: sticky_seconds=600, commit_window_sec=30, shadow_threshold_rps=20, shadow_decay_rate=0.02, commit_cap_per_hour=500000000, telemetry_sample_pct=0.5.

tay: ack. opening PLAT ticket after RFC.

ops-bot: Created ticket PLAT-7920: "Soft billing bands + shadow debit RFC" assigned to sasha (https://tracker/redwood/PLAT-7920) :spiral_note_pad:

kevin: nice work. after canary we should run a billing dry-run report comparing billed amounts with and without shadow logic to validate savings/risks.

rachel: thanks all. will loop in support for early visibility. :thumbsup:

sasha: thanks team — will post RFC link here when ready."
